verdicts.reason: Both lose the blue background, so all the white text is gone: no headline, no URL, no 'HO SMART' wordmark. Each is left with an empty blue parallelogram and a tiny phone photo floating on white. A at least stacks the logo, blue slab and photo down a centre axis, but has stray diagonal stripe lines and a ghost white box at the bottom. B is worse: the logo icon is oversized, cut off at the right edge and jammed against the thumbnail photo, the photo sits beside an empty grey strip, and there are large dead white areas above and below.
